summary.text: Dodie Horton is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 9, representing Bossier, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2015 as the year elected.
The page lists Dodie Horton with committee assignments including Labor and Industrial Relations (Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: It lists Dodie Horton's education as Woodlawn High School.

The House member page lists Dodie Horton's committee assignments as Labor and Industrial Relations (Vice Chair); Administration of Criminal Justice; Appropriations (Elected Member); Legislative Bureau (Chair); House Executive Committee; Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus; North Louisiana Legislative Delegation.
